found.comment: [Sample] Yes – definitions have to come first or the new platform inherits the old conflicts.
Right place, but the issue is that the parts add up to $160,000, not that the total is too low.

overall: [Sample] Good catch on the sequencing, which is the most serious flaw. You missed the unrealistic integration timeline in step 2 – always ask whether durations are plausible for the work described.
